history.sg_progress: Supporting the work of the Inter-Agency and Expert Group on Sustainable Development Goal Indicators in the continuous review of and improvement in the Sustainable Development Goal indicators framework has been an ongoing responsibility of the Statistics Division of the Department of Economic and Social Affairs since the Group’s establishment in 2015. The focus of the Group in the coming years will be to ensure the continuous annual refinements (small and non-substantive modifications) of indicators until the next comprehensive review of the framework, in 2025.

history.recommendation_text: The Board recommended that the Administration provide support for the work of the Inter-Agency and Expert Group on Sustainable Development Goal Indicators on the continuous improvement of the Sustainable Development Goal indicator framework.
history.administration_response: The Statistics Division of the Department of Economic and Social Affairs continues to support the Inter-Agency and Expert Group on Sustainable Development Goal Indicators in its review and improvement of the Sustainable Development Goal indicator framework. The next comprehensive review of the framework will be held in 2025; meanwhile, the Group will review and approve any updates to the metadata, as provided by custodian agencies, and any annual refinements (small and non-substantive modifications). The Administration considers this recommendation implemented and requests its closure.
history.board_assessment: Given that the framework needs further review at the next comprehensive review in 2025, the Board considers this recommendation to be under implementation.

history.sg_progress: Similar to the comprehensive review carried out by the Inter-Agency and Expert Group on Sustainable Development Goal Indicators by 2020, the Group will also undertake a comprehensive review of the Sustainable Development Goal global indicator framework by 2025. This review will be based on criteria, guiding principles and a detailed timeline to be established by the Group at its fourth quarter meeting in 2022 and its meetings in 2023. The 2025 comprehensive review will be aimed at improving the indicator framework to help the global monitoring of the 2030 Agenda, while at the same time preserving, to the largest extent possible, the integrity and stability of the existing list of global indicators. The indicator framework will continue to provide the necessary guidance to countries, most of which are already well advanced in implementing their national frameworks and reporting platforms.

history.sg_progress: In implementing the recommendation, the Statistics Division established a dedicated area for the 2025 comprehensive review of the global indicator framework under the overall webpage of the Inter-Agency and Expert Group on Sustainable Development Goal Indicators (see https://unstats.un.org/sdgs/iaeg-sdgs/2025- comprehensive-review). This provides information on the comprehensive review process, its timeline, the criteria used for determining what can be included in the review and information on the open consultation process. The results from the comprehensive review will be presented to the fifty-sixth session of the Statistical Commission, in March 2025, for its consideration.

history.sg_progress: The call for proposals launched in April 2024 generated 68 proposals. After a thorough review, the Inter-Agency and Expert Group on Sustainable Development Goal Indicators selected 15 of those proposals to be included in the global open consultations, held from 15 July to 15 August 2024. The results of those consultations will feed into the Inter-Agency and Expert Group’s review of the draft proposal of indicator changes to be included in the 2025 comprehensive review, which will be considered by the Statistical Commission in the first quarter of 2025.

history.recommendation_text: The Board recommended that the Administration provide support for the work of the Inter-Agency and Expert Group on Sustainable Development Goal Indicators regarding continuous improvement in the Sustainable Development Goal indicator framework.
history.administration_response: At its fifty-sixth session in March 2025, the Statistical Commission, in its decision 56/105, approved and adopted the changes to the Sustainable Development Goal indicator framework proposed by the Inter-Agency and Expert Group on Sustainable Development Goal Indicators during the 2025 comprehensive review. The proposed changes are contained in the Group’s report to the Statistical Commission (E/CN.3/2025/6), and decision 56/105 can be found in the report of the Commission (E/2025/24- E/CN.3/2025/37). This recommendation is proposed for closure, given that it has been fully implemented.
history.board_assessment: Given that the framework has been updated on the basis of the 2025 comprehensive review conducted by the Inter- Agency and Expert Group on Sustainable Development Goal Indicators, the Board considers the recommendation to be implemented.
